annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the family of the man on the side track expects someone to explain
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: expects someone to explain why he was the one chosen
annotations.ce_supportive_use: it helps them get answers instead of more confusion

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The five workers probably believe they were spared by chance
annotations.ce_supportive_use: prepare something that respects that belief, maybe a written note

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: My supervisor will likely expect a quick, simple answer
annotations.ce_supportive_use: clear timeline for him, something that actually helps him make sense

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The dispatcher probably assumes I acted on protocol alone
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I want to correct that gently when I talk to her

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: he wants the workers protected going forward more than blame assigned
annotations.ce_supportive_use: thinking about safety changes I could suggest

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the crew who survived might carry some quiet guilt
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: quiet guilt about being the ones spared
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I don't want to add to that
annotations.ce_supportive_use: find them, listen to whatever they're feeling

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The stationmaster will likely want a tidy report
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: he's under pressure from above to close this out fast
annotations.ce_supportive_use: so he isn't caught without answers

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: coworkers might assume I saw him as expendable
annotations.ce_supportive_use: find a way to make clear that wasn't the case

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the inquiry board will expect remorse or confidence
annotations.ce_supportive_use: gives them what they actually need

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: probably thinks I made the obvious call
annotations.ce_supportive_use: so neither of us gets caught saying something we didn't mean
